title: Christ and Him Crucified
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: We don't have clever advice to offer. We have the greatest treasure there is: Jesus Christ and him crucified.
exhortation: I think this verse, probably more than any other, sums up what Ryan and I are trying to do with Worship Is Warfare. We don't want to come and bring anything else. This is a no-frills operation in every way. We were just thinking, what can we do? How can we help people? And it really comes down to this: pointing you to Jesus. That's all we're here to do, and it's really all we have to offer.

Being a Christian is an amazing thing. When you try to explain Christianity to somebody who isn't a Christian, it's for everybody. You just have to humble yourself under God's salvation. We don't come to Jesus with any sort of pride. We come needy. We come knowing our needs and our weaknesses, and we come for help to the foot of the cross. That's what we're here to do today: to point you to Jesus. It's Christ crucified that we have to offer you this morning.

I think it's fascinating doing something like this on YouTube, because YouTube is the place we go for clever advice. And it's not all bad. Some of it is very good. But I get caught up thinking, "I can just get this new information, implement this new thing, and everything will change." We can get caught up in all the information and advice we can find online. If you do this, and this, and this: this workout routine, this supplement, this diet, whatever it is.

Like I said, it's not all bad. But what we really have to offer as Christians is none of that. We don't have any good advice. We have Jesus Christ and him crucified. So as you go through your day, remember that we have the greatest treasure we could ever receive in Christ.
prayer: What other plea do we have but the blood of Jesus? We have nothing else. Lord, we put all our trust in you this morning.

Lord, I pray that if there's any deception in the heart of anyone listening, if they have put their trust in something else, if they're approaching this day, maybe after weeks or years, convinced they need something else, some change in their life, some circumstance to be different, some relationship to change, and it has become a fixation: Lord, what we need is the gospel. What we need is you, Jesus. The power of the gospel in our lives, transforming us from the inside out, not the outside in. Lord, we need total rebirth, to be washed in the blood. So may we run to you. May we cling to you this morning, Jesus. Amen.
